    have hp : 2 ^ (n + 1) = 2 ^ n + 2 ^ n := by ring
    obtain ⟨L, p1, e1, x1, h1⟩ := ih f F p fun j hj => hf j (by omega)
    obtain ⟨R, p2, e2, x2, h2⟩ := ih (fun j => f (2 ^ n + j)) (fun j => F (2 ^ n + j)) p1
